headline.text: Two L3 MFM holds — *2 pallets* missing dates after printer fault, plus sensor malfunction caused flavor cross-contact at depositor.

summary: Three holds across L1 and L3 today. L3 MFM printer faulted mid-run creating 2 pallets with no date codes (on hold for rework); separate C6 sensor shift caused product backup and flavor mixing (disposition unknown). L1 S4 Twist Wrap underweight pouches flagged by QA and corrected same shift. One sanitation gap: L3 ML1 buffer tank handed off uncleaned between shifts.

holds.title: MFM printer fault — 2 pallets no date code
holds.summary: Printer faulted during production run, creating 2 full pallets of pouches with missing best-before dates; pallets isolated for manual rework after order complete.
holds.status: On hold pending rework — Frederick confirmed pallets will be reworked after order completion.

holds.title: MFM sensor shift caused flavor mixing
holds.summary: C6 conveyor Z sensor moved out of position, product backed up at depositor and mixed with other flavors; cross-contact risk for allergen-sensitive varieties.
holds.status: Open — sensor repositioned and line restarted; no disposition posted for affected product.

holds.title: S4 Twist Wrap underweight pouches
holds.summary: QA flagged pouch weights below spec at 08:13 MT; side pieces light while center pieces on-target; team adjusted and weights recovered by 10:54 MT.
holds.status: Resolved — weights improved to acceptable range and monitored through end of shift per Nathan Topham.

quality.title: S3 Cross Conveyor 2 damaged hardware
quality.summary: One knob severely bent, two wheels very loose on Cross Conveyor 2 discovered during cleaning; damage mode and timeline unknown.
quality.status: Open — William Lopez requested details on what happened to prevent recurrence.

quality.title: MFM past-date labels found on 3 pallets
quality.summary: Labels verified correct at shift start, but mid-shift check found 3 finished pallets labeled with incorrect (past) best-before date.
quality.status: Open — flagged by QA, no corrective action or disposition posted.

sanitation.title: ML1 buffer tank handed off uncleaned
sanitation.summary: Buffer tank received by 1st shift in unwashed condition; shift handoff cleaning accountability gap.
sanitation.status: Open — flagged in chat with photo; no response or corrective action posted.

opportunities.text: Review Cross Conveyor 2 operation on S3 — severe hardware damage (bent knob, loose wheels) discovered during cleaning with unknown cause.
Consider pre-run printer test protocol on MFM — today's mid-run fault created 2 pallets of undated product before detection.
Review C6 sensor mounting on MFM — sensor shift at 09:29 caused flavor cross-contact at the depositor.
Add buffer tank to ML1 shift handoff checklist — tank handed off uncleaned at 07:46 today, suggesting gap in accountability.
